The '''Relarr system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]], or [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Arrowhead" /> It was situated near<ref name="Journal10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref> the Core Worlds'<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]]. At some point between the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Journal10" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and approximately [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}} establishes that the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" segment of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' represents an [[in-universe]] update to the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', the original version of which is presented in the sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]. The latter work is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> while preparing to land his [[Etti Lighter|starship]] [[Trustworthy (freighter)|''Trustworthy'']] at the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] facilities in the Kuat [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Drolen Antig]] and some of his accomplices [[Death/Legends|killed]] three [[Advozse/Legends|Advosze]] thieves together with whom Antig had recently stolen [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military technology. After Antig and his crew subsequently sold the technology to Kuat Drive Yards, the bodies of the Advozsec were later discovered jettisoned in the Relarr system, a fact that was later noted by the New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in an entry of the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]''<ref name="Journal10" />&mdash;the initial version of which was published in 7 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]<ref name="Dates" />&mdash;dedicated to Antig.<ref name="Journal10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Relarr system was first mentioned in the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" segment of the [[May]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|tenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The segment was authored by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]].<ref name="Journal10" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square M-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
